Strategy: Reward residuals between thirty and forty-five while penalizing residuals between eight and twenty-two more strongly, steering bins toward reusable middle leftovers and away from awkward small gaps. This combines a sweet band with a stronger penalty band, but both limits are guesses and the penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (30 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
